project.name: Recall
project.description: A self-maintaining, vendor-neutral memory system. Three tiers: immutable episodic capture; a semantic consolidated tier (plaintext Markdown as source of truth plus a rebuildable SQLite index); and an offline consolidation loop that reconciles them via a confidence-gated split between a probabilistic LLM classifier (proposes) and a deterministic executor (writes). Product claim: never wrong silently, never loses ground truth, honest about its own measured error rate.
invariants: brain/ is the source of truth; brain/.brainindex/ (SQLite) is a gitignored, fully rebuildable index that must never hold anything not recoverable from the Markdown.
The episodic tier (brain/episodic/) is immutable and append-only; corrections are new captures that reference the old one, never mutations.
Expensive reasoning (LLM classification, consolidation) runs only at write-time / offline, never in the read/query path or a live session-start path.
The probabilistic classifier only proposes; the deterministic executor is the only thing that writes to the semantic tier. The LLM never both judges and acts.
Contradictions are never auto-applied and verification never auto-corrects; both only route to the review queue.

Conflict-classification accuracy has a measured ceiling (~65.3%, CONFLICTS benchmark, frontier models). Any classifier change must report its own measured accuracy on the real eval set, never an assumed one.
Recall reads AIW's tracked files read-only and never writes to .ai/; Recall's write path targets only brain/.
The data format is vendor-neutral plaintext + git and the classifier must stay provider-swappable (Anthropic is the current default, not a lock-in).

Dogfood Recall on its own build: before any recall-v1 task transitions to done, capture that task's non-obvious decisions / conflicts / owner corrections via 'recall capture'. A bad dogfood result is a finding to surface, not to hide. See .ai/decisions/0007.

retrieval-precision-at-scale.title: Retrieval pads to k with near-zero-relevance facts once the store is topically varied
acceptance: A repro case (fixture with >=50 topically-disparate facts) shows RRF fusion returning k results even when fewer than k are meaningfully relevant, with near-flat scores among the irrelevant tail
Either a relevance-score floor/cutoff is added to search(), or sufficiency.check() is tightened to flag this dilution case, or both -- with before/after scores in the eval note
Full test suite still green
constraints: Found via backfill-import-combined: at ~8 facts every query returned everything trivially (masked the issue); at 73 facts across disparate topics (cognitive-architecture vs personal/finance/music), a finance query's #1 result was correct (highest RRF score) but ranks #2-10 were near-random padding with near-identical low scores, and sufficiency.check() did not flag it
retrieval-precision-at-scale.result: Revised pass, verified against the real corpus (97 active facts), not just a synthetic fixture. Root cause: RRF fuses by rank only, discarding raw BM25/cosine magnitude that genuinely discriminates (BM25 -15.3 vs -5.3, cosine 0.23 vs 0.11 for the real reported query) -- a fused-score floor (prior pass) is structurally inert against this; fixed by flooring each signal's raw magnitude pre-fusion (RAW_RELATIVE_FLOOR=0.5 in _bm25_candidates/_vector_candidates). Entity/scope anchoring confirmed never-engaged in production (100% unsorted/null) but confirmed NOT the cause of this case (no named entity in the query) -- filed as known limitation, not built. Chose candidate-pool floor over a smarter sufficiency gate because retrieve_and_format() injects every returned fact regardless of the sufficiency flag. 5/6 real spot-check queries (finance/music/education/project-self) now correct and non-padded; 1 genuine lexical-collision case remains (two unrelated real facts sharing one rare content word) -- documented as an unfixed, out-of-scope-for-lexical-matching limitation in LIMITATIONS.md. New eval/retrieval_quality_set/ (synthetic content, public-repo-safe -- caught and fixed a near-miss where real personal financial content was briefly staged for commit) wired into pytest. 90 tests green. Committed in 3 separable steps (investigation, fix, eval+docs), pushed.
